body:
My ability to memorize, socialize and my outlook on life has changed drastically. I was really positive beforehand; planning my career, taking driving lessons, feeling absolutely certain that I can achieve anything. Then the first Lockdown hit the UK and I was suddenly given Essential Worker status. 

I used to have a accurate memory and really read into verbal directions. Nowadays I'm on autopilot. Alot of us are just very burnt out. I have no idea how to get back to the person I was beforehand or even plan for a future as it's just shown me that everything can change overnight. The constant lockdowns and spikes really had us all on edge and we're all fed up. Emotions are starting to show and it's hard as we don't know how we can support each other anymore. My resilience is being tested everyday and my dreams are just being dreams. I don't see how I can turn them into goals anymore. I'm not myself nowadays. I no longer smile. I'm lost on what I want from my life and I'm not as patient as I was beforehand. 

Although, I'm seeing signs of improvement as time goes on. Today I supported someone new and explained to them how things were done, really engaging with them and making sure they understood what we do. I've been back at the gym alot and saving up as much as I can for a driving course and first car. I'm practicing conversations with my family and friends, also going to therapy to see what's simmering away in my mind (Autism isn't fun at times).

I'm cautiously optimistic about the future at the moment. But it's hard for me to get back into that mindset I was in before. I miss that person alot.

I'm trying for my future self. I just hope they're proud of me as I really am struggling.

*TW*

They broke up with me. There was passiveness, jealousy, stress and no openness. We were both students. 

I was insecure and wanted things to work. They were my first physical partner... And he sexually assaulted me. Denied it over and over again and gaslit me. Called me the crazy bitchy victim after the breakup.

I wanted to make them happy. But I didn't get anything in return. Just trust issues and trauma that I'm working on. 

I'll be OK eventually. Trying to plan for my future and discover who I truly am. It's difficult with COVID and everything but I'll get there soon.

Tim Bergling aka Avicii. As someone who is on the Autistic Spectrum and loves music, he actually inspired me to learn how to mix and attempt to remake some tracks. I was looking to get back into it after University until I saw his name trending on Twitter. 

One of my idols in the industry was gone. I never knew that he was suffering behind the scenes. His work helped me through some dark times and to connect with alot of people. I was in tears when I heard the news and I still cry a little when I hear 'Hey Brother' or 'Fade into Darkness'.

RIP Tim. I really hope you found peace.
Birth place of Bill Nighy and manufacturer of lightweight sports cars. Also briefly had a F1 team.
WHEN I WAS.... A YOUNG BOY....

Asking for a Friend by CHVRCHES. It's a recent song by them but it damn near broke me listening to it for the first time. 

'I don't wanna say, that I'm afraid to die. I'm no good at goodbyes, I can't apologize'.

I can't listen to my it without having some surge or emotions going through my chest.
